title: Stellar cluster and star-forming region M 17
caption: The star-forming region Messier 17, imaged by ESO's Very Large Telescope
celestial: Messier 17 · constellation Sagittarius · about 5500 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: This near-infrared view from ESO's Very Large Telescope looks into the sky region of Messier 17, a glowing cloud of gas energised by a cluster of young, hot stars. Astronomers call such a place an H II region: a cloud in which hydrogen has been ionised by the intense ultraviolet light of hot young stars.

The notable find here lies to the south-west of the cluster's centre: a large disc seen in silhouette. Discs of gas and dust are thought to form around young stars, and seeing one in silhouette lets astronomers trace its outline against the brighter background.

Near-infrared light passes through dust more easily than visible light, which helps in dusty star-forming regions like this one. The image was made with the ISAAC instrument on ANTU, one of the 8.2-metre telescopes of the VLT at Paranal.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (6.05 x 6.10 arcminutes) and distance (5500 light years), the frame spans roughly 9.7 × 9.8 light-years. Its light set out about 5,500 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This is a three-colour near-infrared composite from ISAAC on the VLT, using J, H and K filters. The colour assigned to each filter isn't published.
filters: 1.25 μm · Infrared J (Very Large Telescope ISAAC)

understand.eye: Near-infrared light is invisible to the eye, and it reveals structure in dusty regions that visible light cannot penetrate as well.

explore: Messier 17 lies about 5500 light-years away in the direction of the constellation Sagittarius. This is a three-colour composite built from J, H and K filters, and it covers a field about six arcminutes across.
alt: A near-infrared view of the Messier 17 region, with a silhouetted disc south-west of the cluster centre.
